hook: Dixon became Chancellor of North Carolina Central University in 2024 after leading Elizabeth City State University for over eight years, including as interim and then permanent Chancellor, and after six years overseeing academic and student affairs system-wide for the 17-campus University of North Carolina system. Her research has focused on college access and summer bridge programs.
name: Karrie G. Dixon

quote.text: Experienced Chancellor with a demonstrated history of working in the higher education industry.

timeline.event: Assistant Vice Provost, North Carolina State University
timeline.impact: Leads student diversity initiatives and the Building Future Faculty program in the Provost's office

timeline.event: Senior Associate Vice President for Academic and Student Affairs, University of North Carolina
timeline.impact: Serves nearly seven years in the system office at Chapel Hill

timeline.event: Vice President for Academic and Student Affairs, University of North Carolina system
timeline.impact: Shapes system-wide policy across 17 UNC campuses, 58 community colleges and 36 independent colleges as chief student affairs officer

timeline.event: American Council on Education Fellow, Wake Forest University
timeline.impact: Completes a one-year ACE fellowship studying fiscal operations, governance and undergraduate education models

timeline.event: Interim Chancellor, Elizabeth City State University
timeline.impact: Serves nine months as interim chancellor before permanent appointment
Leads the university for over eight years
Becomes chancellor of NCCU while continuing to lead Elizabeth City State University

quick_facts: Chancellor of both North Carolina Central University (since 2024) and Elizabeth City State University (since 2018)
Doctor of Education in Higher Education Administration, North Carolina State University
American Council on Education Fellow, 2016-2017, at Wake Forest University
Published research on the UNC Academic Summer Bridge Program and rural student college access

achievements.title: Chancellor, North Carolina Central University, 2024-present
achievements.impact: Leads a public historically Black university in Durham, North Carolina.

achievements.title: Chancellor, Elizabeth City State University, 2018-present
achievements.impact: Has led the university for over eight years, including as interim chancellor before permanent appointment.

achievements.title: Vice President for Academic and Student Affairs, UNC system, 2014-2018
achievements.impact: Set system-wide academic and student affairs policy across 17 university campuses as chief student affairs officer.
